Metadata.title: ixnos-data
Metadata.description: Search Greek public procurement and spending

Home.intro: Search Greek public tenders, awards, contracts and payments from ΚΗΜΔΗΣ, in Greek, Greeklish, or by ΑΔΑΜ, ΑΔΑ or VAT number. Records are shown as published, in Greek.

Organisation.awarded: Awards in the last 12 months (excl. VAT)
Organisation.paid: Payments in the last 12 months (incl. VAT)
Organisation.matchNote: Awards come from ΚΗΜΔΗΣ, excluding VAT. Approvals and payments come from Διαύγεια, including VAT, so they are not added together. Contractors are matched by VAT number.

Organisation.dominantNote: One contractor with half or more of the awarded value. It may be the only supplier in the area; not a sign of wrongdoing by itself.

NotFound.title: This receipt was never issued
NotFound.text: The page or record you asked for is not in ixnos-data. The link may be wrong, or the record may not have arrived from its source yet.

Error.title: Something went wrong
Error.text: The page did not load, most likely because the service is unavailable right now.

Login.title: Sign in
Login.intro: Enter your email and we will send you a sign-in link. No password needed. If you have no account yet, it is created when you first sign in.
Login.sent: If the address is right, an email with a link is on its way. It is valid for 30 minutes.
Login.invalid: That email address is not valid.
Login.expired: That link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.

Account.title: My alerts
Account.saved: Search saved. You will get an email every morning with new records.
Account.digestNote: We email you what was newly published for these searches. When nothing is new, we send nothing.
Account.none: You have no saved searches. Run a search and press “Get alerts for this search”.
Account.deleteText: Your email address, saved searches and sending history are deleted permanently.

Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.intro: ixnos-data keeps as little data as possible.
Privacy.storedText: If you create an account: your email address, your preferred language and the searches you save. No password, no tracking cookies, no advertising. One sign-in cookie keeps you signed in.
Privacy.useText: Only to send you sign-in links and the daily summary of new records. We share it with no one.
Privacy.recordsText: Records come from ΚΗΜΔΗΣ and Διαύγεια as published. Sole traders may appear by name; we build no profiles of people and honour removal requests.
Privacy.deleteText: You can delete your account at any time from “My alerts”. All your data is deleted at once.
Privacy.contactText: For removal requests or questions, open an issue in the code repository on GitHub.

ApiKeys.title: API keys
ApiKeys.intro: For programs that use the ixnos-data API. Send the key in the X-Api-Key header for your own rate limit. Documentation and daily data exports are on the Developers page.
ApiKeys.created: Your new key. Copy it now: it will not be shown again.
ApiKeys.limit: You already have the maximum number of keys. Revoke one to create another.
ApiKeys.name: Key name
ApiKeys.revokeConfirm: I understand that programs using this key will stop working

Developers.title: For developers
Developers.intro: Everything in ixnos-data is open: a public API for search and records, and daily exports of every record.
Developers.apiText: Search, records and organisations as JSON, with the same search and filters as the website. The documentation describes every endpoint and lets you try them.
Developers.keysText: Keys are free: sign in and create one on the page
Developers.exportsText: Every morning, every record as CSV and JSON Lines (gzip), with the organisations. No contractor data.
Developers.licenceText: The data comes from ΚΗΜΔΗΣ and Διαύγεια under CC BY 4.0: credit the sources when you reuse it. The ixnos-data code is open source (AGPL-3.0).

Feed.title: ixnos-data: {search}
Feed.description: The newest records for this search on ixnos-data.

Signal.label: Worth a second look
Signal.single_offer_note: A competitive procedure that received a single offer. Common in small markets; not a sign of wrongdoing by itself.
Signal.near_direct_award_limit_note: A direct award within 5% below the legal limit (€30,000, or €60,000 for works, excluding VAT). Not a sign of wrongdoing by itself.
Signal.title: Signals

Help.title: How it works
Help.intro: ixnos-data gathers public tenders and spending from two official sources and makes them easy to search. It adds no data of its own: it shows what the sources publish, with a link to the original.
Help.sourcesText:
ΚΗΜΔΗΣ (the Central Electronic Registry of Public Contracts): requests, tender notices, awards, contracts and payments. Every record has an ΑΔΑΜ code.
Διαύγεια (the transparency portal): commitment, spending-approval, payment and award decisions. Every decision has an ΑΔΑ code.
New records arrive every hour; the time of the last update is at the bottom of every page. Both sources are licensed CC BY 4.0.
Help.stagesText: A public contract goes through stages: request, tender notice, award, contract, payment. Every record shows its stage and links to the others when the source names them. Διαύγεια decisions link to ΚΗΜΔΗΣ contracts through their ΑΔΑ.
Help.codesText: The trade is a CPV code, the common European procurement classification (e.g. 33600000-6, pharmaceutical products). The region is a NUTS code (e.g. EL543, Ioannina). Filtering by a broad code includes the narrower ones under it.
Help.amountsText:
ΚΗΜΔΗΣ amounts exclude VAT; Διαύγεια amounts include it. So they are never added together, and every amount states its basis. When an amount looks like a data-entry error at the source, it is marked.
Contractors are matched across the two sources by VAT number. The VAT number itself is neither shown nor exported.
Help.searchText: Type with or without accents, even in Latin letters (katharismos). An ΑΔΑΜ or ΑΔΑ code opens that record; a VAT number shows that authority's or contractor's records. Press / on any page to start a search.
Help.correctionsText: When a Διαύγεια decision is corrected, the old one stays reachable but points to the new one and no longer counts in totals.
Help.signalsText: Some records carry signals: facts from the source worth a second look. They are not accusations. The rules are fixed and public, and every signal rests only on what the source publishes.
Help.concentrationText: On an authority's page: one contractor won at least half of the value of the last 12 months' awards, across at least 3 awards, when the authority made at least 10. It may be the only supplier in the area; not a sign of wrongdoing by itself.

Status.title: Status and metrics
Status.intro: How much data ixnos-data holds, how fresh it is, and how much it is used. Updated every minute.
Status.unavailable: The metrics are unavailable right now.

Tape.title: Taped receipts
Tape.intro: The records you put on the tape, stuck together in one strip. This page's link shows them to anyone you send it to.
Tape.empty: The tape is empty. Open a record and press "Add to tape" to add it (up to {max}).
Tape.totalNote: The two totals are not added together: one excludes VAT, the other includes it.

Static.failed: The data didn't load. Check your connection and reload the page.
Static.searchNote: Search runs on your device: it finds words from the title and their forms, in Greek or Greeklish. Results are shown newest first.

Alerts.title: Alerts by RSS
Alerts.intro: This edition of ixnos-data has no accounts: new records arrive by RSS. Add a feed to an RSS reader (e.g. Feedly, Inoreader, Thunderbird) or to a service that emails feeds to you. Each feed holds the 50 newest records and updates with the data.
Alerts.copy: Copy the feed's address and add it to your reader.
